schema: VietlishCorpusEntry (src/lib/tutor/vietlishCorpus.ts) - { vietlish, natural, sourcePattern, category, frequency, context }
author: A5 (Content Factory wave 15)
definition: Fifteenth-wave candidate Vietnamese-L1 interference items for human review before promotion into VIETLISH_CORPUS. Focus areas: stative progressive calques, synthetic comparatives, serial verb chains, aspect markers, S-V agreement errors, question word order, adjective order, false friends (bored/boring, good at/in, discuss about, attend, sympathize), uncountable noun errors, body-pain literal translations, register mismatches, collocation errors (make/do/play/take, listen to, apply for, borrow/lend), and embedded question word order.
dedupedAgainst: A5 local check against live VIETLISH_CORPUS plus pending waves 1-14, case-insensitive vietlish matching.
